sents.t: Today is the Fourth of July.
It is Independence Day, America’s birthday!
In the morning, there is a parade on Main Street.
There are bands, firefighters, and old cars.
Everyone wears red, white, and blue, and there are American flags on every house.
In the afternoon, there is a big barbecue in Rosa’s backyard.
Rosa’s son, Danny, cooks hamburgers and hot dogs on the grill.
There is also corn, potato salad, and watermelon.
For dessert, there is an apple pie with stars on it.
“Food, family, friends, and fireworks! That is the Fourth of July,” Danny says.
At night, we walk to the park.
At nine thirty, the fireworks start.
There are big red, gold, and blue lights in the sky.
Max doesn’t like the noise, so Rosa stays home with him.
It is my first Fourth of July, and it is wonderful.
